## Appearance

Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face and prominent blue eyes. He presents a neat and snug appearance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison is an outspoken man who has earned a reputation as a crank, describing himself as crusty, crabbed, and lonesome. Despite his outward sharpness, he is also known to be quite kind, showing outward sympathy when needed. Over time, he has become a changed man, though he maintains a fastidious nature.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), +2 more_

## History

Harrison, a [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) man who lived in Scottsford, moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after previously visiting Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy. Having kept house with his sister until her death, he fulfilled a promise to her by marrying [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott after delaying marriage for a long time. However, following a two-week wedding trip to St. John, the couple separated over issues involving his foul-mouthed parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). In [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison initially clashed with his neighbor [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after accusing her cow of ruining his oats, but he warmed to her after she accidentally sold his Jersey cow and came to confess the mistake. Their friendship grew through frequent visits, during which Harrison voiced his doubts about Anne's teaching methods, refused to donate to her village improvement canvass, and accidentally locked Davy's twin, [Dora](../character/dora.md), in his toolhouse. His life took a sharp turn when a severe hail storm destroyed his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), shortly after which his estranged wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for him and the two reconciled. Harrison remained a candid presence in Anne's life, later providing blunt critiques on her fictional story and informing her of a baking powder story contest that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) secretly submitted Anne's work to win. During a winter holiday, he visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) once again to deliver the mail to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), +45 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He’s . . . he’s always talking nonsense. I got him from my brother who was a sailor. Sailors don’t always use the choicest language, and parrots are very imitative birds."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> "has she gone and broken into my oats again? Well, never mind . . . never mind if she has. It’s no difference . . . none at all, I . . . I was too hasty yesterday, that’s a fact. Never mind if she has."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Mr. Harrison and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are neighboring residents who develop a warm friendship after a rocky start. Their acquaintance begins with heated arguments over wandering cows, including an incident where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly sells Mr. Harrison's cow, but his calm response leads to them sharing tea and becoming close. Though he expresses doubt over her teaching methods and refuses her fundraising requests, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently visits him to chat about local affairs and village projects.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +25 more_

- Friend of — neighbors who become good friends  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>
